```{r}
library(FSNA)
```

## Elicitation without mouse tracking

`fuzzify_responses()` converts four kinds of responses into TFNs:

* **three-point** (recommended): lowest plausible, most plausible and highest
  plausible value, i.e. a direct statement of a triangular possibility
  distribution;
* **interval**: a range slider and a most plausible value inside it;
* **confidence**: a value and a confidence rating, converted into a symmetric
  spread;
* **linguistic**: a label from a term set (`linguistic_scale()`), with an
  optional second label for hesitation between adjacent terms.

```{r}
d <- data.frame(rater = "a", rated = c("b", "c", "d"), best = c(8, 4, 6), confidence = c(5, 2, 4))
fuzzify_responses(d, "confidence", scale = c(0, 10), confidence_scale = c(1, 5))
d <- data.frame(rater = "a", rated = c("b", "c"), label = c("strong", "moderate"), label2 = c(NA, "strong"))
fuzzify_responses(d, "linguistic")
```

## A web form

`make_collector()` writes a self-contained HTML page with the names of the
members. Each respondent selects his or her name and, for each colleague, sets
the three values with sliders while the triangle is drawn. Answers are sent to a
Google Sheet through a Google Apps Script web app, whose code is in
`system.file("collector", "google_apps_script.gs", package = "FSNA")`, or
downloaded as CSV. The page can be embedded in a Google Site.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
make_collector(c("Alba", "Bruno", "Carla", "Dario"), file = "form.html",
               endpoint = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec", open = TRUE)
```

## From the sheet to the report

```{r}
f <- system.file("extdata", "three_point_example.csv", package = "FSNA")   # synthetic answers
d <- read_ratings(f)                       # also .xlsx with readxl, or a CSV URL
head(d, 3)
x <- fsn_from_ratings(fuzzify_responses(d, "three_point", scale = c(0, 10)), drop_isolated = FALSE)
x
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
res <- fsna_analyze(x, output_dir = "analysis", open = TRUE)
```

```{r}
res <- fsna_analyze(x, output_dir = NULL, indices = c("in_strength", "in_closeness_prod"))
res$certification_summary
```

## Simulated questionnaires

`simulate_ratings()` generates mouse-tracking style ratings with nonresponse,
latent working groups and repeated ratings, in the format of the questionnaire data (`?fsna_questionnaire`).

```{r}
s <- simulate_ratings(30, seed = 1)
xs <- fsn_from_ratings(s, from = "rater", to = "rated", order = "order")
xs
```
